dimensions.label: Direct experimental variant-effect measurements
dimensions.description: Multiplexed/deep mutational scanning, MPRA and other assays that measure the effect of specific variants.

dimensions.label: Protein structure, stability, activity and interactions
dimensions.description: Protein sequence/function annotation, domains, structural models and stability predictors.

dimensions.label: Transcription, splicing, regulatory elements, tissue-specific expression
dimensions.description: Expression by tissue, regulatory element maps, splicing effect predictions and sequence-to-function models.

dimensions.label: Knockout, knockdown, CRISPRi/a, overexpression, knock-in and rescue experiments
dimensions.description: Genome-scale perturbation screens and model-organism knockout phenotypes.

dimensions.label: Human natural knockouts, constraint and dosage sensitivity
dimensions.description: Loss-of-function tolerance, observed/expected metrics and curated haploinsufficiency/triplosensitivity.

dimensions.label: Genetic association, fine-mapping, LD and colocalisation
dimensions.description: GWAS associations, credible sets, molecular QTLs, colocalisation and locus-to-gene evidence.

dimensions.label: Functional haplotypes and pharmacogenomics
dimensions.description: Star-allele/haplotype definitions, gene-drug annotations and guidelines.

dimensions.label: Structural variation and copy-number variation
dimensions.description: Population SV/CNV catalogues, dosage-sensitive regions and clinically curated CNVs.

dimensions.label: Repeat expansions and short tandem repeats (STR/VNTR)
dimensions.description: Pathogenic repeat loci, reference tandem-repeat catalogues and population repeat distributions.

dimensions.label: Pathways, molecular interactions, epistasis and compensation
dimensions.description: Curated pathways, protein/genetic interactions and network context.

dimensions.label: Clinical variant interpretation and disease association
dimensions.description: Clinically classified variants, gene-disease validity and phenotype links.

dimensions.label: Population allele frequencies and haplotype structure
dimensions.description: Allele counts/frequencies across ancestries, phased haplotypes and reference panels.

dimensions.label: Integrated variant annotation and predictors
dimensions.description: Tools and resources that aggregate predictors and annotations per variant.

dimensions.label: Reference genomes, transcripts and gene models
dimensions.description: Assemblies, transcript sets and identifier mapping required to place every evidence type on one coordinate system.

dimensions.label: Resource catalogues and classifications
dimensions.description: Registries of databases, standards and tools used to discover and classify resources.

dimensions.label: Background documentation and terminology
dimensions.description: Educational and documentation material that explains concepts and projects but contains no variant-level evidence.

dimensions.label: Complex loci, paralogs and region reliability
dimensions.description: Context that decides whether a variant call and its interpretation are reliable or confounded: segmental duplications and paralogs, gene-conversion and pseudogene-rich loci, HLA, KIR and immunoglobulin loci, collapsed or falsely duplicated assembly regions, low-mappability and tandem-repeat regions, alternate and patch sequences.

lifecycle: A catalogue record exists with provenance
Live probes returned usable data from this environment (or a documented block)

Every file that supports the dimension is downloaded and verified against the size/checksum the source publishes (where it publishes none: Content-Length plus our own SHA-256, and the manifest says so); 'partial' when only some are
The acquired files parsed and passed checks against the source's own description (headers, documented counts, ranges, identifier formats)
A demonstrated join to the existing dc assets passed, and it exercised a file that supports the dimension
Computed: acquired, validated and mapped for that dimension, with a licence verified live that permits research use. Not a claim that an analysis pipeline exists

A documented, tested query layer in this repository returns the source's records by variant, gene, protein or region. Not built in this phase, so no source is credited with it; 'usable' is the highest stage computed

evidence_kinds.direct_experimental: A measurement of the effect of specific alleles in an assay (for example deep mutational scanning, MPRA, saturation genome editing)
evidence_kinds.perturbation_experimental: A gene- or region-level perturbation in cells or model organisms (knockout, knockdown, CRISPRi/a, overexpression); not allele-specific unless stated
evidence_kinds.population_observation: Allele or genotype observations in cohorts (frequency, homozygosity, constraint derived from them); indirect evidence about function
evidence_kinds.statistical_association: A statistical association between variants and a trait or molecular phenotype (GWAS, QTL, fine-mapping, colocalisation); association is not mechanism
evidence_kinds.curated_expert_classification: A classification or assertion made by curators or expert panels from other evidence (clinical significance, gene-disease validity, dosage sensitivity, star-allele function)
evidence_kinds.computational_prediction: A model or algorithm output; a hypothesis about effect, never a measurement
evidence_kinds.reference_annotation: Reference sequence, gene models, transcript sets, region annotations and identifier maps
evidence_kinds.experimental_structure: Atomic structures or residue coverage determined experimentally
evidence_kinds.aggregated_integration: A resource that aggregates and harmonises records from other sources; evidence kinds of the parts persist
evidence_kinds.catalogue_metadata: Descriptions of resources (catalogues of databases and tools), not biological evidence
evidence_kinds.documentation: Educational or background material with no variant-level data
evidence_kinds.experimental_annotation: Assays of the biochemical activity of the genome (chromatin, binding, expression) that annotate regions or genes without measuring the effect of a particular allele
evidence_kinds.case_observation: Observations of variants in affected individuals or families (case series, cohorts ascertained on phenotype, segregation); ascertained on phenotype, so frequency in cases is not a test of association

allele_resolutions.allele_specific: Records refer to specific alleles (chromosome, position, reference, alternate or an exact protein change)
allele_resolutions.haplotype_level: Records refer to haplotypes, star alleles or named alleles composed of several variants
allele_resolutions.variant_class_level: Records refer to classes of change (for example any loss-of-function change in a gene)
allele_resolutions.gene_level: Records refer to genes or proteins as a whole (constraint, knockout phenotypes, essentiality); they do not describe any particular allele
allele_resolutions.region_level: Records refer to genomic intervals or loci (regulatory elements, CNV and repeat regions, difficult regions)
allele_resolutions.protein_residue_level: Records refer to residues, domains or structures of a protein

mechanism_bases.direct: The source measures the effect or mechanism itself
mechanism_bases.curated: Experts assert the effect or mechanism from other evidence
mechanism_bases.association: A statistical association; the mechanism is not shown
mechanism_bases.prediction: A computational prediction; a hypothesis to be tested
mechanism_bases.population: Indirect evidence from frequency, constraint or selection
mechanism_bases.context: Annotation needed to interpret mechanisms (gene models, structures, regions) without itself asserting an effect
mechanism_bases.case: Observed in affected individuals or families, ascertained on phenotype; supports a candidate relationship but is not a controlled test

source_relations.identical_records: Both sources carry the same underlying records; combine them once, not twice
source_relations.derived_from: This source is built from, or re-expresses, the other; treat as one lineage
source_relations.aggregates: This source aggregates the other among others; prefer the aggregate for reuse and the original for fields the aggregate drops
source_relations.independent_related: Independent measurements or curations of related phenomena; keep both and compare
source_relations.may_conflict: Independent assertions that can disagree; never merged, disagreement is information

mechanism_axes.label: Clinical or trait outcome (mechanism-agnostic)
mechanism_axes.description: Assertions or associations that link variants or genes to a disease, trait or molecular phenotype without establishing how: clinical significance, gene-disease validity, GWAS and QTL associations.
mechanism_axes.competing: causal variant versus a linked variant; ascertainment and testing bias; population-specific effects; reverse causation or confounding in association; classification circularity when predictors were calibrated on the same labels
mechanism_axes.discriminating: fine-mapping and colocalisation, independent replication, functional assays, segregation, review status and conflicting-interpretation flags

mechanism_axes.label: Protein function, stability and interactions
mechanism_axes.description: Altered activity, stability, folding, localisation or interactions from amino-acid substitutions, in-frame indels and start or stop changes.
mechanism_axes.competing: loss versus gain of function; destabilisation versus active-site or interface disruption versus mislocalisation; dominant-negative versus haploinsufficient; a coding change acting instead through splicing or translation
mechanism_axes.discriminating: allele-specific functional assays, structure and interface context, domain annotation, expression and dosage data, segregation and clinical classification

mechanism_axes.label: Truncation, frameshift and nonsense-mediated decay
mechanism_axes.description: Premature termination, frameshifts, start loss and stop loss: decay of the transcript (haploinsufficiency) versus stable truncated proteins.
mechanism_axes.competing: decay versus escape (last exon, 50-nucleotide rule); alternative start codons; exon skipping that restores frame; transcript-specific effects; genes that tolerate loss of function
mechanism_axes.discriminating: transcript structure and decay rules, expression across transcripts (pext), loss-of-function curation, constraint, population loss-of-function counts, clinical classification

mechanism_axes.label: Splicing
mechanism_axes.description: Disrupted or created splice sites, exonic and intronic regulators, branch points and deep-intronic pseudoexons; exon skipping, inclusion and cryptic sites.
mechanism_axes.competing: a splicing effect versus a protein effect of the same exonic change; partial versus complete; tissue-specific; rescue by cryptic sites
mechanism_axes.discriminating: splice predictors, tissue RNA-seq splice events and sQTLs, minigene or MAVE splicing assays, transcript structure

mechanism_axes.label: Transcriptional regulation
mechanism_axes.description: Promoters, enhancers, silencers, insulators, transcription-factor binding, chromatin accessibility, 3D contacts and expression QTLs.
mechanism_axes.competing: causal variant versus linkage with the causal variant; tissue- or state-specific effects; target-gene ambiguity; enhancer redundancy and buffering
mechanism_axes.discriminating: fine-mapping and colocalisation, MPRA and CRISPRi/a, chromatin and cCRE annotation, allelic imbalance, tissue specificity

mechanism_axes.label: UTR, RNA stability and translation
mechanism_axes.description: 5 prime and 3 prime UTR variants, miRNA and RNA-binding sites, polyadenylation, RNA structure, upstream open reading frames and translation initiation.
mechanism_axes.competing: transcript abundance versus RNA stability versus translation efficiency
mechanism_axes.discriminating: ribosome profiling, UTR reporter assays, conservation, binding-site annotation

mechanism_axes.label: Gene dosage
mechanism_axes.description: Copy-number loss or gain, or loss of function, causing haploinsufficiency or triplosensitivity; imprinting; compound heterozygosity.
mechanism_axes.competing: dosage versus disruption of regulatory elements (position effect); contiguous-gene effects of multi-gene CNVs; mosaicism; incomplete penetrance
mechanism_axes.discriminating: dosage-sensitivity curation, constraint, population CNV frequencies, gene content of the interval

mechanism_axes.label: Structural rearrangement
mechanism_axes.description: Inversions, translocations, insertions and complex events: gene disruption, fusion transcripts, disruption of regulatory domains.
mechanism_axes.competing: breakpoint gene disruption versus enhancer hijacking versus dosage change versus mobile-element effects
mechanism_axes.discriminating: breakpoint mapping, domain (TAD) annotation, expression, long-read resolution

mechanism_axes.label: Repeat expansion and instability
mechanism_axes.description: Short tandem repeat and VNTR length change: toxic RNA, polyglutamine proteotoxicity, silencing, somatic instability.
mechanism_axes.competing: length threshold versus repeat interruptions and purity versus somatic mosaicism versus modifiers; motif identity
mechanism_axes.discriminating: locus catalogues with thresholds and motifs, population allele-size distributions, long-read repeat sequence

mechanism_axes.label: Pharmacogenomic haplotypes
mechanism_axes.description: Star alleles, including copy-number and hybrid alleles, that set enzyme or transporter activity and drug response.
mechanism_axes.competing: function assigned by haplotype versus by the individual variant; phase ambiguity; rare variants outside the haplotype definitions; structural alleles; drug-specific effects
mechanism_axes.discriminating: allele-definition tables, function and phenotype assignments, guideline evidence, long-read phasing

mechanism_axes.label: Paralogs and complex loci
mechanism_axes.description: Variants in segmental duplications and paralog or pseudogene-rich or highly polymorphic loci (HLA, KIR, SMN1 and SMN2, CYP2D6 and CYP2D7, GBA and GBAP1): mis-mapping, gene conversion, copy-number polymorphism.
mechanism_axes.competing: a true variant versus a paralogous sequence variant that was mis-mapped; gene conversion versus point mutation; copy-number-dependent genotype; a reference-sequence artefact (collapsed or falsely duplicated region)
mechanism_axes.discriminating: region annotation of duplications and mappability, assembly-aware calling, long reads, haplotype-specific references

mechanism_axes.label: Population frequency and constraint
mechanism_axes.description: Indirect evidence from allele frequency, homozygosity, constraint and selection.
mechanism_axes.competing: tolerance versus pathogenicity inferred from frequency; founder effects; ascertainment bias; absence from a callset is not evidence of harm
mechanism_axes.discriminating: ancestry-specific frequencies, coverage, constraint with confidence intervals, curated loss-of-function variants

mechanism_axes.label: Genetic interaction, epistasis and compensation
mechanism_axes.description: Epistasis, pathway buffering, paralog compensation, modifier loci and oligogenic or digenic effects.
mechanism_axes.competing: paralog compensation versus pathway redundancy versus modifier alleles; a gene-level knockout result does not describe a particular allele
mechanism_axes.discriminating: combinatorial perturbation screens, interaction and pathway context, modifier association evidence

mechanism_axes.label: Mitochondrial DNA variation
mechanism_axes.description: mtDNA variants: heteroplasmy, tRNA, rRNA and protein-coding effects under the mitochondrial genetic code, maternal inheritance.
mechanism_axes.competing: heteroplasmy level and tissue distribution versus nuclear modifiers; threshold effects
